name: panel_reproducibility_audit_and_failure_analysis
description: Answer P4 at panel scale: run the frozen ten-step reproducibility audit over every published figure of the province panel for all four treatments, then analyse what is actually lost when a figure cannot be reproduced.

fixture.role: the real-revision evidence fixture audited at H9C; its numbers are carried forward unchanged

panel.role: every published figure of the frozen province panel, audited here for the first time

scope.synthetic_requests: none; injected revisions are audited at H11 and stay there

access.B1: observation_id in any state the table retains

materiality.material: the figure that cannot be reproduced carries a value different from the one the treatment now serves for that cell
materiality.duplicate_value: the figure that cannot be reproduced carries the same value the treatment now serves, so no published value is lost
materiality.why_it_matters: a recall rate alone cannot tell a lost revision from a lost duplicate, and only the first is a reproducibility failure with consequences

cross_check.rule: for every sweep point k, the measured official recall of B0 and B2 must equal the derived count minus k, and that of B1 and B3 must equal the derived count
cross_check.why: the audit is derived from the frozen panel, so it must agree with what the physical sweep actually returned

lineage.graph: the H6C lineage built over the frozen panel
lineage.requirement: every request resolves to exactly one source record and one source artifact
lineage.completeness: complete paths divided by requests, reported as a ratio

measurement_boundary.timing: not measured here; H11 and H12 measure cost
measurement_boundary.physical_execution: not repeated here; the panel recall was executed physically at H11 and is cross-checked against it

invariants: the ten frozen audit steps are unchanged since H8C
all four treatments answer exactly the same request set
every failure is classified, and no failure is left unexplained
every request resolves to its source record through the lineage
the derived recall agrees with the recall the physical sweep measured
B1 and B3 report no failure, and any failure they did report would stop the audit
the fixture numbers audited at H9C are carried forward unchanged, never recomputed
